messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — model canary redwood-v2-canary error rate ↑ 4x in us-east-1. On-call: @Maya. Link: https://alerts/redwood/1950012345

Maya (oncall): I'm awake, taking. What's current impact?

Ethan (sre): I'm pulling logs now. Seeing 502/504 spikes on generation endpoints. Starting tail: /var/logs/inference/gpu-3.out

Priya (ml): I see model-side stacktraces in the canary image. Pasting short snippet:
```json
{"timestamp":"2025-03-15T11:04:22Z","error":"kv_cache negative length","stack":"..."}
```

Nina (eng-runtime): GPU metrics show memory spike on gpu-3 and gpu-6 at 11:03-11:06. OOMs and queued requests.

Maya (oncall): Customer impact? any flagship customers affected?

Jordan (prod): Support reports two customers seeing elevated latency and failed requests. CS is on it. No broad user-visible outage but degraded for some.

Maya: Plan for now: (A) pause canary traffic, (B) pin/roll back to stable, (C) capture timeline and artifacts. Agree?

Ethan: On it. Pausing traffic to canary: `rbctl route update --model redwood-v2-canary --weight 0` — running.

Ethan: Command finished, draining connections. Current weight 0 -> confirmed.

LogCollectorBot: Archive created at s3://ci-logs/1950012345/canary-logs.tar.gz

Priya (ml): Quick diff from build pipeline: the canary image bumped MAX_SEQ from 4096 -> 8192 and upgraded tokenizers. Patch below:
```diff
- MAX_SEQ=4096
+ MAX_SEQ=8192
```

Priya (ml): Also the build includes tokenizer v2.4.7 -> v2.5.0 which changes byte offsets for some languages.

Nina: runtime shows repeated message: `kv_cache.resize(-12) assertion failed` on three hosts: gpu-3,gpu-6,gpu-11. That points to cache bookkeeping bug.

Ethan: Hypothesis 1: MAX_SEQ increase causes unexpected negative resize due to arithmetic overflow in kv cache handling.

Priya: Hypothesis 2: tokenizer change changes input token counts triggering an edge path in attention/kvcache.

Maya: Evidence collection: Priya please attach model config, Nina attach kernel logs, Ethan attach nginx/proxy logs. I'll build timeline.

Ethan: proxy logs: first 502 at 2025-03-15T11:02:07Z, error rate climbs until 11:08 then drops after we drained traffic.

Nina: kernel log snippets (extracted):
```text
[11:03:45] kv_cache: resize request 32768 -> -1
[11:03:46] gpu oom: process pid 2345 killed
```

Priya: Model config: `max_seq=8192` and `kv_capacity_hint=32768` in canary. Stable has `max_seq=4096` and `kv_capacity_hint=16384`.

Maya: Decision: roll back canary image to stable tag v1.2.3 and un-pause traffic to stable. If stable is already receiving traffic, ensure pin remains.

Ethan: Rolling back: `rbctl model pin redwood-v2 v1.2.3` -> done. Confirmed traffic routing to stable.

Jordan: Notifying support channels and affected customers now — drafting message and will post to #support-notifications.

Maya: Good. Next: do we need a full rollback of the canary deploy or is it isolated to canary only? Looks canary-only; no full prod deploy of that image.

Priya: Canary build included both tokenizer and max_seq change. We should split those in next attempt and test kv cache under large seq.

Nina: Temporary mitigation: add runtime guard to reject max_seq>4096 until kv cache fix and more tests. I can push a hotfix flag: `--max-seq-cap=4096`.

Ethan: Applying runtime guard on nodes: `rbctl exec --nodes gpu-* -- cmd --max-seq-cap=4096` -> started rolling update.

Ethan: Guard applied on 12 nodes. Monitoring for regressions.

Maya: Timeline summary (for RCA draft):
- 11:00: canary deploy started (pipeline #7645)
- 11:02: first 502 observed
- 11:03: kv_cache negative resize errors appear on gpu-3/gpu-6
- 11:05: error rate spikes (4x)
- 11:07: incident declared and pager triggered
- 11:09: canary traffic paused
- 11:11: model pinned to v1.2.3
- 11:20: runtime guard applied

Priya: I'm going to reproduce locally with max_seq=8192 and tokenizer v2.5.0 to confirm failure mode.

Maya: Handing on-call to Ethan for night watch at 12:00 UTC. Maya -> Ethan.

Ethan: Taking watch. I'll follow up with a short postmortem with logs, diffs, and recommendations. Assigning follow-ups: Priya will validate tokenizer split; Nina will run unit test for kv cache; Jordan will own customer comms.

Jordan: Noted. I'll also escalate to account teams for the two impacted customers.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Will file the incident issue and link artifacts. Incident thread closing for active triage; maintain updates in the issue.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity=minor, status=mitigated, link=https://incidents/1950012345
